analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA analysis script

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

metadata.description: Key metrics and flags reported by the analysis script

experiment_json_loaded.description: Whether experiment_[ID].json could be loaded by the analysis script

num_peaks.description: Number of UV peaks detected in the chromatogram

data_files.description: Paths to data output files produced by the analysis script

analysis_results_json.description: Path to main analysis results JSON file

chromatogram_csv.description: Path to CSV file containing parsed chromatogram data (time, UV, conductivity)

peaks_csv.description: Path to CSV file containing detected peak table (if peaks were found)

chromatogram_png.description: Path to PNG chromatogram plot with peak annotations

chromatogram_pdf.description: Path to PDF chromatogram plot with peak annotations

files_processed.description: Number of files written by the analysis script (as reported in its results JSON)

results_folder.description: Listing of all files present in the results folder at commit time

folder_path.description: Absolute path to the results folder

files.description: List of filenames present in the results folder
